records.jp: ううう、くらくらする……
records.en_original: Ngh, I feel so dizzy...
records.en: Ngh, I feel so dizzy...

records.jp: うーん、軽い貧血かな。<CR>ちょっと無理して歩き回りすぎたね
records.en_original: I think you overdid it a little. We've been walking around a lot without much rest.
records.en: Hmm, perhaps mild anemia.<CR>We walked around too much without enough rest.

records.jp: ほら、ベッドで休もう？
records.en_original: Why don't you lie down for a bit on the bed there?
records.en: Why don't you lie down for a bit on the bed there?

records.jp: ……やだ
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ベッドは、やだ
records.en_original: I don't wanna. Not on that bed.
records.en: I don't wanna. Not on that bed.

records.jp: やっぱり、昔のことで？
records.en_original: Oh... Does it remind you of what you went through?
records.en: Oh... Does it remind you of what you went through?

records.jp: ……うん。<CR>いろいろ、思い出しちゃうんだよ
records.en_original: Yeah. Just looking at it brings back all sorts of horrible memories...
records.en: Yeah. Just looking<CR>at it brings back all sorts of horrible memories...

records.jp: 無機質で、真っ白な天井とか
records.en_original: The plain white ceiling, cold and indifferent.
records.en: The plain white ceiling, cold and indifferent.

records.jp: 味のしない病院食とか
records.en_original: The bland hospital food.
records.en: The bland hospital food.

records.jp: 変わり映えのしない窓からの景色とか
records.en_original: The same boring view from the window, day in and day out...
records.en: The same boring view from the window, day in and day out...

records.jp: 全部、全部、嫌いだから……
records.en_original: I hated it. I hated all of it.
records.en: I hated it. I hated all of it.

records.jp: でも、自分の体は大切にしなきゃ。<CR>私、勇希が無理して倒れちゃったりしたら嫌だよ
records.en_original: But you need to take care of yourself. I'd hate for you to push yourself too hard, Yuki.
records.en: But you need to take care of yourself.<CR>I'd hate for you to push yourself too hard, Yuki.

records.jp: ……うん。分かってる。ごめん
records.en_original: ...I know, I know. Sorry.
records.en: ...I know, I know. Sorry.

records.jp: ううん、謝らなくていいよ。<CR>勇希がベッドを嫌う理由は、分かるから
records.en_original: You don't need to apologize, Yuki. I know why you can't stand to lie down on that bed.
records.en: You don't need to apologize, Yuki.<CR>I know why you can't stand to lie down on that bed.

records.jp: ……あはは、そうだよね。<CR>今更、誤魔化してもしょうがないよね
records.en_original: ...Ahah, of course you do. I should known better than to try to hide things from you, Ao.
records.en: ...Ahaha, of course.<CR>There is no point trying to hide it now.

records.jp: ……ねえ、愛央。<CR>あたしが寝るまで、一緒にいて？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao... You'll stay with me until I fall asleep, right?
records.en: Hey, Ao... You'll stay<CR>with me until I fall asleep, right?

records.jp: 勇希……？
records.en_original: Yuki... Are you okay?
records.en: Yuki... Are you okay?

records.jp: 起きてると、いろいろ、嫌なこと考えちゃうから。<CR>だから……寝るまででいいから
records.en_original: All sorts of awful things come into my head when I'm trying to get to sleep. So if you could stay, just until I fall asleep...
records.en: All sorts of awful things come into my head when I'm trying to get to sleep.<CR>So if you could stay, just until I fall asleep...

records.jp: ……うん。分かった
records.en_original: Of course. I'll be right here.
records.en: Of course. I'll be right here.

records.jp: 具合はどう？
records.en_original: How are you feeling?
records.en: How are you feeling?

records.jp: ……うん。ちょっとずつ良くなってきた
records.en_original: A little better.
records.en: A little better.

records.jp: そか。安心した
records.en_original: I see. I'm glad.
records.en: I see. I'm glad.

records.jp: ……ごめん。迷惑かけて……
records.en_original: Sorry for being such a hassle...
records.en: Sorry for being such a hassle...

records.jp: もう、気にしなくていいのに。<CR>こんなこと、なんでもないんだから
records.en_original: Hey, I told you, it's nothing. Really.
records.en: Hey, I told you,<CR>it's nothing. Really.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: ……勇希、なんだか――
records.en_original: Yuki, you...
records.en: Yuki, you...

records.jp: 甘えんぼさんだね
records.en_original: You just like being pampered, don't you?
records.en: You are being rather needy.

records.jp: そ、そうかな
records.en_original: Y-you think...?
records.en: Y-you think...?

records.jp: そうだよ。撫でてあげよっか
records.en_original: Totally. Here, let me stroke your hair.
records.en: Totally. Here, let me stroke your hair.

records.jp: や、やだ！　恥ずかしいよ……
records.en_original: N-no way! That'd be weird...
records.en: N-no way! That'd be weird...

records.jp: ふふ。可愛い
records.en_original: Hehe. You cutie.
records.en: Hehe. You cutie.

records.jp: いつもより元気がないね
records.en_original: You seem a bit less chipper than usual.
records.en: You seem a bit less chipper than usual.

records.jp: そ、そんなことない、とは言えないか。さすがに……
records.en_original: A-am not! ...Okay, maybe a little.
records.en: A-am not! ...Okay, maybe a little.

records.jp: うむ、自覚的でよろしい。<CR>早くいつもの勇希に戻ってよ？
records.en_original: Good, I'm glad you know yourself. Now get some rest and bring back the Yuki I know and love!
records.en: Good. I approve of that self-awareness.<CR>Hurry and get back to your usual self, all right?

records.jp: は、はいっ……
records.en_original: O-okay...
records.en: O-okay...

records.jp: ……どうしたの？
records.en_original: ...What's wrong?
records.en: ...What's wrong?

records.jp: なんだか、全然平気だなって思って
records.en_original: Nothing. I was just thinking about how at peace I feel...
records.en: Nothing. I was just thinking about how at peace I feel...

records.jp: 平気？　ベッドが？
records.en_original: At peace? Even in that bed?
records.en: At peace? Even in that bed?

records.jp: うん。愛央と話してると……不思議と落ち着くんだ
records.en_original: Yeah. Talking to you...just makes me feel weirdly calm.
records.en: Yeah. Talking to you...just makes me feel weirdly calm.

records.jp: 嫌なことも思い出さないし、<CR>みんなとの、楽しい思い出が蘇ってくる
records.en_original: Instead of bad memories coming to mind, I think of the good times we've all had together.
records.en: Instead of bad memories coming to mind,<CR>I think of the good times we've all had together.

records.jp: 助けになれたならよかった。<CR>いつでも頼っていいからね
records.en_original: I'm glad I could help, even just a little. You can always count on me, okay?
records.en: I'm glad I could help, even just a little.<CR>You can always count on me, okay?

records.jp: ……ありがと、愛央
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao.
records.en: Thanks, Ao.

records.jp: じゃあ、みんなにも感謝しないといけないね
records.en_original: You better say thanks to everyone, then!
records.en: You better say thanks to everyone, then!

records.jp: 病院で埋め尽くされていた思い出を、<CR>みんなで塗り替えた。きっとそのおかげだよ
records.en_original: All your horrible memories of being in the hospital must have been replaced by the good memories we've made together.
records.en: We all painted over the memories that had been filled entirely by the hospital.<CR>I am sure that is why.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: ほら、そろそろ寝よう。<CR>寝るまではずっとそばにいてあげるから
records.en_original: Time to get some rest, Yuki. I'll be right here.
records.en: Time to get some<CR>rest, Yuki. I'll be right here.

records.jp: ……分かった。おやすみ、愛央
records.en_original: Okay. Goodnight, Ao.
records.en: Okay. Goodnight, Ao.

records.jp: うん。おやすみ、勇希
records.en_original: Goodnight, Yuki.
records.en: Goodnight, Yuki.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
